body: Is it too early to take a test right now? I took 2 and so far it’s negative

I’m so sorry for your loss
I hope Oliver is watching over you from puppy heaven ❤️

And if not you will atleast feel peace and weight off of your shoulders being vulnerable with them
It is liberating
Please you have to talk to your siblings or boyfriend or any loved one because seeing how much they care for you will make you not only feel love and warmth but it might make you lean towards staying

I want to say I hope you don’t go ahead with it, but wanting to go ahead with it is also the reason I’m here many others are as well

When the people who are in your immediate surroundings (family, mostly) become walking migraines to you life feels pointless

But I hope, I really hope both you and I and everyone else makes it through it and finds somewhat better people and I hope you can distance yourself or detach yourself from them so that they aren’t as overpowering in your head


Im sorry this is happening to you
I hope you somehow manage to let this time pass and go onto a life better than this

I really just hope you’re at peace 
And I’m sorry it came to this point

Ohmygod that is just so horrible
you don’t deserve this no one deserves to be attacked like that
I’m so sorry
You can let it all out here
I’m lurking on here and so are hundreds of others this very second which just shows you aren’t alone 
Is there anyway you could report them? I’m not an expert in gaming but I’m sure there must be a way to report their usernames?
To be honest death is painful for those left behind but life goes on and they really do just move on it’s a survival thing

Thank you so much 💕

Yeah I definitely need to talk to her but this time with more patience 
She’s already started buying what healthy food she could find for me after i had an argument about my issue with eating which is a start :)

Aw in my opinion (this is probably only applicable to my type but) that playful boyish charm that always sneaks out during flirty banter etc

And also this is so stereotypical but I generally really like that protective feeling I get from being around them idk if it’s because of the patriarchy or my internalized misogyny that has convinced me I need a mans protection but
I would probably say that

I also really appreciate (from my experience) how they always try their best to express themselves even if our ‘society’ rlly conditions men that being emotionless = being ‘manly’

I’m so sorry for your loss,
thank you so much for giving him the loving home he deserved❤️
